description: ECDH-ES on an Ed25519 and an X25519 key returns the X25519 key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): ECDH-ES is served by P-256, P-384, P-521 and X25519 keys, and Ed25519 never matches ECDH-ES (RFC 8037 §3.2); member 1 has no alg, use (U = enc from ECDH-ES) or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
